claims.claim: First arXiv submission 2019-12-03; v3 2020-03-17; PDF explicitly identifies publication at ICLR 2020.
claims.evidence_location: arXiv Submission history; v3 PDF page 1 header

claims.claim: Representation uses the current observation; transition predicts without it; the reward model predicts one-step rewards. RSSM follows PlaNet and combines deterministic memory with stochastic latent states.
claims.evidence_location: Section 2 Eq. 1; Section 4 Model implementation; Fig. 3

claims.claim: Behavior learning uses latent imagined trajectories without decoding future images; actual actions are sampled from the learned actor rather than online lookahead search over candidate sequences.
claims.evidence_location: Sections 1–3; Algorithm 1; official blog Efficient Behavior Learning

claims.claim: Tanh Gaussian actions and continuous latent state sampling allow pathwise gradients; discrete actions use straight-through gradients. Reparameterization expresses the same sampling distribution as a differentiable computation.
claims.evidence_location: Section 3 Action and value models / Eq. 3; Learning objective

claims.claim: Finite-horizon reward sums, k-step returns and lambda-returns differ in bootstrapping beyond the imagination window. Gamma discounts future reward; lambda weights rollout lengths.
claims.evidence_location: Section 3 Eq. 2 and Eq. 4–6; Fig. 4

claims.claim: The actor maximizes imagined lambda-return through model state transitions, rewards and values. The critic fits stop-gradient return targets. Model parameters are fixed during behavior learning, while gradients with respect to inputs are retained.
claims.evidence_location: Section 3 Learning objective / Eq. 7–8; Comparison to actor critic methods

claims.claim: Reward-only, reconstruction and contrastive estimation are compared as alternative representation objectives. Reconstruction includes reward/observation prediction and posterior-prior KL regularization. Reconstruction works best on most tested tasks; contrastive solves about half.
claims.evidence_location: Section 4 Eq. 9–12; Section 6 Learning latent dynamics / Fig. 8

claims.claim: Random seed episodes initialize replay; model learning, imagined behavior learning and new real experience collection repeat. Pure latent imagination describes behavior learning and does not mean the agent avoids real interaction.
claims.evidence_location: Algorithm 1; Section 2

claims.claim: Main experiments use 20 visual continuous-control tasks selected from previous work with nonzero image-input performance, 64x64x3 observations and fixed action repeat 2; hyperparameters are shared across separately trained tasks.
claims.evidence_location: Section 6 Benchmarks / Implementation; Appendix A

claims.claim: Each run uses one Nvidia V100 and 10 CPU cores; reported throughput is about 3 hours per million environment steps. Fig. 6 reports Dreamer mean 823 after 5 million steps, PlaNet 332, and D4PG 786 within 100 million steps, using 5 seeds.
claims.evidence_location: Section 6 Implementation / Performance; Fig. 6 caption

claims.claim: Value bootstrapping reduces sensitivity to imagination horizon. Appendix C extends the method to selected discrete-action/early-termination tasks rather than a comprehensive Atari benchmark.
claims.evidence_location: Section 6 Comparison of methods / Fig. 7; Appendix C

teaching_examples_not_paper_experiments: Scalar Gaussian action a=mu+epsilon and R(a)=a: pathwise gradient 1; no-baseline REINFORCE at mu=0 gives a^2, expectation 1 and variance 2. This is not a universal variance guarantee.
Differentiable toy model x'=x+2a, R=1-(x'-1)^2: x=0,a=0.2 gives R=0.64 and derivative 2.4; a=0.21 gives R=0.6636.
Undiscounted two-step bootstrap 1+2+7=10; finite lambda mixture 0.5*8+0.25*10+0.25*12=9.5.

analysis_not_paper_claims: Action-conditioned prediction does not establish intervention-effect identifiability in confounded observational IT data.
Temporal causal attention and task-token isolation do not constitute causal identification guarantees.
IT migration requires action-aligned trajectories, delayed/failed operation records and evaluation of actual recovery outcomes; RCA labels alone do not supply these trajectories.
Model-internal policy improvement, predictive quality and real-system execution benefit require separate evaluation.
Production safety and cloud deployment benefits are not demonstrated by these game/simulation results.
